name: banner-relay
description: Shows the dev box's finished-response banners on the Mac, through VS Code's own connection to the box

bannerRelay.box.description: The box's name for a banner's click. Empty to take it from the window's connection.

bannerRelay.queuePath.description: The banner queue's path on the box. Empty to find it from the open folder's home.

bannerRelay.scriptsDir.description: Where the Mac's banner scripts are. Empty for the folder `t nli` installs them to.

bannerRelay.intervalSeconds.description: How often to look for new banners, in seconds.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license -o banner-relay.vsix
